title: Mimic Ores
description: This mod adds Mimic ores that when broken makes a mimic and the mimic mimics you!
body:
# Mimic Ores

Mimic Ores is an exciting mod that introduces Mimic ores to the Minecraft game, allowing players to find such interesting mimics!

## Mimics ores
**This includes all deepslate ores**

- Diamond
- Emerald
- Gold
- Iron
- Redstone
- lapis
- Copper
- Coal
- Ancient Debris

# Where are they?

The ores spawn underground!

# Info

When broken it spawns a mimic the mimic, mimics you!

Supported Versions
Minecraft 1.21.8
Neoforge
